label: late-episode reset dip deepened by a1->S2 (rare) and unrewarded trials, raised by a2->S1
terms: (ep_trial/99.0)**4*(phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (ep_trial/99.0)**4*(phase == D2) * (state == 2) * (action == 1) ;; (ep_trial/99.0)**4*(phase == D2) * (state == 1) * (action == 2) ;; (ep_trial/99.0)**4*(phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (ep_trial/99.0)**4*(phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (ep_trial/99.0)**4*(phase != D1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (ep_trial/99.0)**4*(phase == D2) * (action==1)
explanation: Raw reset gate r29 sits near 1 (mean 0.975) and dips toward the end of the episode (timing alone R^2 0.73, strongest at D2). The deviations beyond timing grow with episode time, so every term is scaled by (ep_trial/99)^4 (this scaling raised dev R^2 from 0.35 to 0.39 for the same terms). At D2 the gate is lower after a1 reaches S2 (rare), higher after a2 reaches S1 (rare), and a little higher for a1 overall. At D1 it is lower when the previous trial was a1 reaching S2, whether or not it was rewarded. At GO and D2 it is lower after an unrewarded previous trial. A small graded belief term (lower when the ideal observer thinks S1 is good, at D1 and D2) adds a little. Observed only: test R^2 beyond timing 0.42 (dev 0.40), against an all-observed reference of 0.41 and an all-cue ceiling of 0.46, so leaving out the model policy and value (policy decile alone 0.26) costs little. Large late-episode dips after rewarded D1s and at common a2->S2 D2s still go unexplained.
